{{Quote|We have debated the philosophy you mention.''"<br />"''Good for you! Debate would seem to be a good thing for dead people to do. It would keep the cemeteries lively. And how did your vote turn out?''"<br />"''Here, we do not vote.''"<br />"''Because your lord of the dead decides everything.|Burra and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Burra''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] and a member of the [[Baran Do]] Sages, a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization on Dorin. He later became a member of the [[Hidden Ones]], a secret sect of the Baran Do dedicated to preserving their knowledge, should the order ever be destroyed. Burra, who took that name upon joining the Hidden Ones, was one of the eldest members of the sect present in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] when [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], arrived on Dorin in search of [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master of the Baran Do Order]] [[Koro Ziil]], hoping to find out more about why the Jedi Knight [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].

The Skywalkers soon discovered the Hidden Ones, and traveled with [[senior combat instructor]] [[Chara|Charsae Saal]] to the [[Caverns of the Hidden One|system of caverns]] that were home to the sect. Ziil, who had recently become the [[The Hidden One (disambiguation)|Hidden One's leader]], told the Skywalkers that in order to protect the sect's secrecy, they would not be allowed to leave the caverns. After Luke [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One|defeated]] Ziil in a duel of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], Burra revealed to the Skywalkers the location of a secret [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] chamber out of the caverns.

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Luke Skywalker, who confronted the Hidden Ones about their beliefs]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] was a member of the [[Baran Do]] Sages, a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization on Dorin. Sometime after [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he joined the [[Hidden Ones]], a secret sect of the Baran Do formed by Sage [[Tokra Hazz]], dedicated to preserving their knowledge so that if the Baran Do on the surface were destroyed, the organization could be restored. He changed his name to Burra in doing so, reflecting that his former self was considered [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Outcast" />

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for failing to prevent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Luke and his son, Knight [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to the [[Baran Do temple]] on Dorin to speak with [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Master of the Order]] [[Koro Ziil]], hoping to find the cause of Solo's fall to the dark side. Upon their arrival, however, they were told that Ziil had died, and the two decided to stay and train with the Sages.<ref name="Outcast" />

During their stay, the Skywalkers attended the [[dying ceremony]]&mdash;a ceremony in which a Sage pretended to die and then traveled to a [[Caverns of the Hidden One|system of caverns]] that were home to the Hidden Ones&mdash;of [[senior combat instructor]] [[Chara|Charsae Saal]]. However, Luke wasn't fooled by Saal's "death," and after searching the site, the Skywalkers found Saal alive and well. Realizing that Ziil was likely still alive as well, they traveled with Saal to the caverns. Once there, they found that Ziil was in fact alive and had become the leader of the Hidden Ones and taken the title of [[The Hidden One (disambiguation)|The Hidden One]]. Ziil told the Skywalkers that in order to protect the sect's secrecy, no one who came to the caverns could ever leave. The Skywalkers were further informed that they would have to change their names, as all Hidden Ones did, and accept that they were dead to the outside world.<ref name="Outcast" />

===Leaving the Hidden Ones===
{{Quote|The tunnel out is just above the garment storeroom.''"<br />"''Burra, not ''you''.''"<br />"''The ceiling there is synthstone, artfully detailed to match the natural stone around it. A few blows with chisels will reveal a sliding hatch. Above it is a turbolift chamber. Its generator will need maintenance before it can be activated.|Burra betrays Koro Ziil and provides the location of the secret turbolift chamber|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
During their stay, Luke developed a theory that the Hidden Ones&mdash;by rejecting life and vitality and accepting death&mdash;had all but turned their backs on the Force, while Ben discovered the triggers for a system of explosives that could be activated from any room to block off the only known exit from the caverns. The Skywalkers later announced that they were having a naming ceremony&mdash;a ceremony in which new members of the Hidden Ones chose their new names. Burra, who by that [[Time/Legends|time]] was one of the eldest members of the Hidden Ones, attended the ceremony in Ziil's [[throne chamber]] along with all of the other Kel Dors in the caverns. However, once the Hidden Ones had gathered, Luke revealed that he intended to change the Hidden Ones' own names, restoring them to life, and proposed his theory. Burra spoke up, telling him that the Hidden Ones had discussed Luke's theory. Burra also revealed that the Hidden Ones didn't vote; their leader decided everything. Luke continued to propound his theory over the Hidden Ones' protests, and Ben dueled Saal&mdash;now known as Chara&mdash;with hardwood staffs in an attempt to prove Luke's point. Chara was by far Ben's superior, having taught him combat techniques during Ben's time with the Baran Do, but Ben defeated him because he possessed the will to win. Ziil, however, still did not listen to reason, claiming that Luke had brainwashed Chara into believing that his powers were weakening, causing him to lose.<ref name="Outcast" />

[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ben Skywalker, whose revelation of Ziil's lies finally caused Burra to turn against Ziil]]
To resolve that problem, Ziil revealed that he had told those on the surface that the Skywalkers had died when a cave collapsed, and they would no longer need their [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-[[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] canisters. Without the canisters, the Skywalkers would die from Dorin's [[Helium/Legends|helium]]-rich [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] within a couple of [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Burra finally openly protested against Ziil, but the latter refused to listen, even after other Hidden Ones&mdash;including the female Kel Dor [[Ithia]]&mdash;spoke out against him. Ziil then confronted Luke in a [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One|duel]] of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], which Luke won. After his defeat, Ziil decided that he would allow the Skywalkers to live, but he still refused to let anyone leave the caverns. Frustrated with Ziil's continued defiance, Ben set off the explosive system with the Force, collapsing the exit. Ben then began to reveal to the Hidden Ones the many lies that Ziil told them, such as the claims that there was only one tunnel in and out of the caverns and that Ziil could use [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]] to teach new sages on the surface should they be wiped out, but Ziil still insisted that there was no way out of the caverns. At last, Burra revealed that he knew of a secret [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] chamber which led to the surface of Dorin, and Luke, Ben, and the Hidden Ones returned to the surface.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That is not our way, Master.|Burra, to Koro Ziil, on the matter of killing the Skywalkers|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Burra was a Force-sensitive, but after he joined the Hidden Ones, he was forced to accept that he was dead to the outside galaxy. He was one of the eldest members of the Hidden Ones, and appeared to be deeply trusted by Koro Ziil, being one of the few Hidden Ones other than Ziil himself&mdash;perhaps the only other&mdash;to know of the secret exit from the caverns. Burra was somewhat set in tradition; he had questioned the wisdom of the Hidden Ones before Luke Skywalker debated with him on the subject, but he seemed to have turned a blind eye to the matter rather than look for answers. Yet Burra was no fool, and came to see that Luke was right that in rejecting life, his ability to touch the Force had diminished. He objected when Ziil announced that he was going to kill the Skywalkers, pointing out that such an act was not the Baran Do way. Still, Burra felt obligated to remain loyal to his leader, and even after Ben revealed the many secrets that Ziil had kept from the other Hidden Ones, Burra was hesitant to reveal the secret turbolift exit to the Skywalkers.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Burra was created by the established ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Aaron Allston]] for his first novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', released on [[March 24]], [[2009]].
